newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP drains PLN 296 mln from Polish money market. [CORRECTED 13:12 GMT]
newsitem.headline: NBP drains PLN 296 mln from Polish money market. [CORRECTED 13:12 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects amount of money drained from 260 mln to 296 mln.)
The National Bank of Poland drained 296 million zlotys from the market through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 279 million with the central bank, the NBP said.
The bank drained the market for seven days at an unchanged maximum rate of 21.63 percent.
The maximum rate for 14 days rose by 0.01 point to 21.65 percent from the last auction on January 30.
